summary: The psalm contrasts those who trust Yahweh with those who turn toward a lie. A related form describes those who deviate or the acts by which they turn aside.

senses.definition: Those who turn toward falsehood stand alongside the proud as people whose example the faithful avoid.
Hosea associates turning aside with slaughter. The psalmist rejects the work of those who turn aside.

note: The Psalm 101:3 noun has sin where the Hosea form has samekh. The syntax of Hosea 5:2 and the identification of its first two words are disputed. No independent cognate establishes the sense.
